# Parano1d v2.1.0 Testnet

v2.1.0 improves exact-tip propagation, peer discovery and synchronization
recovery under load. It remains compatible with v2.0.1 and continues on the
same public testnet chain. Existing chain data, wallet data and settings are
preserved; no reset or migration is required.

Exact block availability now propagates through ordinary peers instead of
remaining concentrated on seed nodes. A synchronization plan may obtain exact
bodies and its recursive terminal from different peers, preserves verified
progress across source loss and only pauses mining after complete exact data
has been admitted.

Seed resolution follows the operating system's
VPN-aware resolver first and retains DNS re-resolution as a fallback.

Stale-gap recovery no longer sends a duplicate header request while exact
synchronization is already active, and its timer is refreshed after locally
accepted and externally mined blocks.

The testnet genesis, consensus rules, block format, network profile and embedded
HistoryStep proof pack are unchanged.

Block target: 20 seconds.

GUI packages include the wallet, full node and built-in CPU miner. Core
archives contain the daemon, CLI and external miner. Release assets are built
for Linux x86-64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86-64, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS
Intel.
